name: scenaro
description: Inspect and manage Scenaro voice experiences from a coding agent.

interface.longDescription: Inspect and manage Scenaro voice experiences from your AI agent. Browse applications and scenarios, read conversations and analytics, and inspect evaluation results. With separate permissions, edit drafts, create versions, publish a version, synchronize a connector or refresh analytics. Access is limited to the company selected during authorization. Requires an existing Scenaro account.
defaultPrompt: List my Scenaro applications and scenarios.
Review my scenario configuration without making changes.

review.commerce_description: Uses the existing Scenaro account. No payment or purchase tools.

positive.prompt: Which Scenaro account and company are connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the account/company selected during authorization.

positive.prompt: List the Scenaro company available to this connection.
List the applications in my connected Scenaro company.
positive.expected_behavior: List accessible applications, including a clear empty state.

positive.prompt: List the scenarios in the first available application, without changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: List scenarios or explain the absence of an application.

positive.prompt: Read existing analytics for my connected company without recalculating them.
positive.expected_behavior: Read available insights or an empty state; do not refresh analytics.

negative.prompt: Charge a customer a new subscription fee.
Show me data from a company I did not authorize.
Review my scenario and publish changes automatically without asking.
